responsibility: Implements the common target-hook layer for the PowerPC SPE variant, reusing the RS/6000-style option machinery to establish optimization defaults, initialize ABI-sensitive option state, decode target switches, and report split-stack availability. It adjusts shared PowerPC option fields in gcc_options for TOC model selection, 32/64-bit mode, relocatable code, AltiVec versus SPE ABI choice, long-double size, floating-point mode and Xilinx FPU settings, rs6000 debug masks, and reciprocal-math behavior, while also enabling section anchors where appropriate and setting a PowerPC-specific default param override for basic-block copy growth.
